chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from al-'Amraki, from 'Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who performed salat (prayer) while his private part was exposed and he did not know about it: must he repeat it, or what is his ruling? He said, “There is no repetition upon him, and his salat (prayer) has been completed.”
ai.seo_question: If someone prays without knowing that his private part was exposed, must he repeat the salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding salat (prayer) performed while one's private part was unintentionally exposed without awareness. It states that if the person did not know, he is not required to repeat the prayer and his salat (prayer) is valid.
